# FreetoShop — Clone Stamp Milestone 1

## Task
Implement a Photoshop-familiar Clone Stamp tool in the FreetoShop browser image editor (Milestone 1 of a long-horizon engineering goal). Working directory: `C:/Users/disti/benchmark_work/freetoshop_pi_vs_orchid_20260820/arm-b-orchid`.

## Repository structure
Monorepo with `apps/web` (browser app) and packages: `core-document`, `command-history`, `compositor`, `renderer`, `raster-engine`, `selection-engine`, `filter-engine`, `transform-engine`, `text-engine`, `file-codecs`, `persistence`, `benchmarks`, `pixel-storage`. Tests live in `apps/web/src/...` and `packages/*/src/`. E2E in `tests/e2e/`.

## Architecture constraints (from ARCHITECTURE.md)
- `apps/web`: interaction, accessibility, PWA, view state. Workers handle long-running local ops.
- `core-document`: serializable editor state, layer ordering, stable IDs, invertible affine layer transforms, validated edits, editable shape geometry/styles, text content/styles, ordered typed layer effects, nondestructive parameters, smart-object source trees, smart-filter state, nondestructive canvas geometry. Crop/Canvas Size change canvas bounds; translate only root-layer world placement; remap canvas-sized selection/channel data without trimming layer-local pixels/masks. Reveal All derives expanded rect from nested transformed renderable-layer bounds.
- Pixel layers own immutable sparse `TiledPixelStore` resources; patches replace only changed tiles; history may share unchanged resources. Raster masks use one-channel `TiledCoverageStore` with copy-on-write mask patches.
- `command-history`: applies undoable commands, owns undo/redo history.
- `compositor`: DOM-free premultiplied-alpha source-over, 20 separable + 6 RGB-vector blend modes, immutable/in-place same-sized composition.
- `renderer`: document + viewport → Canvas 2D pixels; must not mutate document; rasterizes affine pixel/rect/ellipse/path/text layers, resolves clipping and group isolation, rasterizes local and document-space raster/vector masks (including masks over combined pass-through and isolated group results), recursively composites smart filters.

## Milestone 1 required behavior
- Alt/Option-click establishes clone source; UI clearly indicates whether source exists.
- Pointer painting samples pixels from source, writes into destination using existing brush/raster workflow.
- Aligned mode preserves source-to-destination offset throughout a gesture and across stroke segments.
- Unaligned mode restarts sampling from source origin as required by tool convention.
- Clone sampling and destination writes use correct transformed-layer coordinate mapping.
- Respects active selection (clips writes to selected region).
- Respects current mask/edit-target model; does not write to wrong layer or mask.
- Single pointer gesture = one atomic undoable history transaction. Undo/redo restore exact pixels and layer state.
- Save/reopen or existing local recovery preserves edited pixels and relevant document state.
- Missing source state handled visibly and safely; painting without source must not silently corrupt pixels.
- Clone source, aligned/unaligned, coordinate relationship must be an explicit testable data model, not implicit UI-handler state.
- Reuse tiled stores and coordinate helpers. Do not materialize entire canvas/layer for a clone operation.
- Add focused unit tests: source/destination pixel correctness, multi-segment aligned strokes, unaligned restart, transformed layers, selection clipping, masks/edit targets, tile-boundary behavior. Add browser workflow using real pointer/keyboard events; verify undo/redo plus persistence/recovery.
- Do not regress existing Brush or Eraser behavior.

## Current state
Just started. Inspected top-level files and directory structure. Next: read ARCHITECTURE.md (in progress), DOCUMENT_MODEL.md, toolRegistry.ts, and relevant existing brush/raster/tool infrastructure to find the correct extension points before implementing.

## Key decisions to make
- Where Clone Stamp tool lives in the toolbar/tool family.
- How clone source state is modeled (explicit data model vs UI-handler state).
- How aligned/unaligned offset is tracked across stroke segments.
- How sampling coordinates map through layer transforms.
- How the operation integrates with command-history for one atomic transaction per gesture.
- How selection clipping and mask/edit-target are applied.
- How to reuse existing brush/raster workflow without materializing full canvas.

## Blockers
None yet. Need to read more architecture/docs and existing tool/brush code to determine implementation approach.

- `paintMaskStroke(mask, layerTransform, points, options, selection?)` mirrors `paintStroke` but operates on a `RasterMask` coverage store, returns `CoveragePatch`, supports `reveal`/`conceal` modes.

- `compositeSourceOver(pixels, offset, color, coverage)` does premultiplied source-over into a pixel array.
- `transformPoint`, `invertTransform`, `multiplyTransforms` are the affine helpers.
- `adjustBrightness` / `adjustBrightnessPixelStore` show the pattern for full-layer vs patch-based edits and selection-bounded work: null selection = full-layer work set; otherwise densify only selection bounds, map to layer-local bounds via inverse, read only that region.
- `resizeImage`/`resizeLayer` show transform remapping for pixel stores, coverage stores, masks, and children; relevant for coordinate mapping but not directly for clone.
